admission.justification: The chosen link rule and its two rejected alternatives constrain every future reference surface; a bare-name change must re-weigh collision against cost.

alternatives.option: Resolve by one server request; nested-only bare names stay text, pathed and top-folder bare names link.
alternatives.reason: The Parent disposition keeps the previously working unique-bare link only where it cannot collide, and the single-request resolve bounds cost by reference count.

alternatives.option: Restore the dropped unique-anywhere bare-name link (a bare name occurring exactly once anywhere in the tree links).
alternatives.reason: Parent d388e211 sections 1-2 expressly drops this third way: a bare name existing only in a sub-folder stays plain text, with no scan, index, fallback or second lookup (Expected Evidence 2); restoring it reintroduces the tree walk the packet removes. CODE-05 stays closed as no regression.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The packet is amended to admit tree-wide resolution with a cost bound.

alternatives.option: Search the whole tree for every bare name.
alternatives.reason: Tree search reintroduces unbounded cost on large masters, breaking the rule 8 bound.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The cost protocol admits tree search within the ceiling with retained proof.

consequences: Reference links are exact or absent; no guessed link is ever rendered.
context: The task page must link references to notes without rescanning the tree, under Parent ruling L126-REFERENCE-FORMAT-RULING (d388e211).
decider: Parent ruling d388e211 (L126-REFERENCE-FORMAT-RULING), carried in the R5 dispositions.

evidence: listing tests + read tests (live/archived open, refusals incl. preserved partial-chain 409); pytest green
